author: HansAndreas_L

title: Excellent highly recommend Valery
text: We forgot to book early and ended up with a 5pm tour that we thought was bad timing as it was the hottest part of the day. We ended up with a completely private tour for just the two of us with Valery. Her English language skills were superb along with her local knowledge. Her passion for Alhambra shone through especially as she told us about the recent closure of the tower due to earth quake crack! The breeze kept the tour really comfortable as Valery taught us more about the culture and history. We hope she gets her wedding at the Alhambra ;)
author: Ysabel_V

title: Highly recommend!
